title: polypodium lineare var. thunbergianum
intro: Polypodium lineare var. thunbergianum, commonly known as Chinese spleenwort, is a type of fern native to East Asia and Southeast Asia. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, thanks to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chinese spleenwort include reducing swelling, relieving coughs, and treating bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant are not extensively documented, but it is believed to contain flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other bioactive compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
